scientific_purpose: Controlled duration ablation after completed 100-epoch nested validation: same network, splits, seeds, thresholds and aggregation policies, only 20 versus 100 training epochs. Test whether probability-scale instability is related to extended fitting rather than use a twelve-hour Live opportunity to guess.
selection_rule: Predeclare 20 epochs as one duration ablation, no hyperparameter search. Compare every policy with its matching 100-epoch result. Do not select a blind payload from post-hoc maxima or treat probability calibration alone as evidence of ranking improvement.
limitations: Each outer evaluation excludes all test-group measurements before five-model construction and threshold fitting. Effective model training size is 64 percent of development versus 80 percent for blind deployment; same relative algorithm, smaller evaluation sample. Historical cached whole-ensemble scores are used only for matching retrospective rank-rate diagnostics, never to select nested thresholds. Resampled conditional intervals omit training and protocol-selection uncertainty.
